ko.executive_summary: Samsung's Exynos 2700 (2nm) demonstrates 20% performance advantage over Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 in internal CPU and GPU benchmarks, expected to power the Galaxy S27 flagship.
key_facts: 20% faster in CPU and GPU workloads vs Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6
Benchmarks from Geekbench and Graphics tests

implications.text: Exynos 2700 establishes Samsung's in-house chip design strength, reducing dependence on Qualcomm and potentially increasing ASP flexibility for Galaxy flagships.
TSMC's 2nm process may not deliver anticipated performance gains for Snapdragon, questioning the technology node roadmap and its cost-performance tradeoff.

ko.counterpoint: Internal Samsung testing may reflect controlled conditions; real-world performance and power efficiency data from shipping devices necessary to validate superiority claims.
